title: refactor: remove Economics ingest tooling
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes obsolete tracked Economics ingest scripts and generated reconciliation artifacts
- Moves provider collection and validated write guidance into the Economics provider skill
- Removes the dead provider-audit package command and stale documentation references
- Preserves SOPS-encrypted credentials and all ignored local evidence data
- Verified with 293 tests, TypeScript, and the production build

gist.headline: The old ledger shed closes
gist.blurb: A retired Economics ingest toolkit has been packed away, while the useful provider-collection instructions moved into their proper skill. The encrypted keys and local evidence stayed safely in the cupboard.
gist.summary: Removed obsolete Economics ingest scripts, generated reconciliation artifacts, the dead provider-audit package command, and stale docs, while consolidating provider collection and validated-write guidance into the Economics provider skill.
gist.impact: Economics maintenance now has one current provider-collection workflow to follow, with SOPS-encrypted credentials and ignored local evidence data preserved.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy garden shed being tidied after an old ledger-ingest machine is retired: labeled paper ledgers, obsolete script scrolls, and reconciliation reports are neatly packed into a compost bin, while a fresh provider-guide book sits on a glowing terminal. Polli, wearing a tiny archivist visor and carrying a clipboard, supervises beside secure locked jars representing preserved encrypted credentials; small code-plants grow around the workstation.
